name: Schema Drift Detector
description: Detect and visualize structural changes, breaking regressions, and schema evolutions in API responses across executions with JSON and XML support.
author: Voiden Team
readme: Detect API response schema drift across executions. Supports JSON & XML responses, breaking change detection (missing fields, type mutations, nullability changes), non-breaking additions, customizable wildcard/regex ignore rules, baseline schema pinning, response panel diff view, and report exports (Markdown, JSON, HTML).

buttons.description: Opens Schema Drift Manager to review API baselines and drift history

ui.description: Adds Schema Drift Detector to sidebar, response panel, and status bar

features: Infer structural response schemas from JSON and XML payloads
Detect breaking schema changes (missing fields, incompatible types, nullability changes)
Track non-breaking changes (new fields, optional extensions)
Configurable field ignore rules with wildcard and regex matching (e.g. *.timestamp, data[].id)
Baseline schema manager with auto-record and manual pin/lock options
Integrated Response Panel view with visual diffs and status badges
Export comparison reports to Markdown, JSON, HTML, and Text formats
Optional CI / headless integration for automated drift testing
